274717566.description:
Assorted Crystal Cluster Lot
Natural and Treated Specimens
Total Weight: 2 lbs
This curated lot features three distinct mineral specimens, showcasing natural geological formations and artisanal color enhancements. The set includes a substantial amethyst geode slice, displaying a dense concentration of deep purple crystalline structures within a rocky matrix. Accompanying this are two aura quartz clusters-one in vibrant golden-yellow and the other in rich magenta-red-each treated with a metallic vapor process to produce a striking iridescent, prismatic luster across the crystal terminations.
Natural purple crystalline geode slice with deep violet terminations
Two iridescent treated quartz-style clusters with brilliant metallic finishes
Three-piece specimen lot ideal for decor, collection, or display
Diverse textures and colors ranging from earthy to prismatic
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. Stones exhibit natural terminations and textures inherent to mineral specimens. The purple crystals are intact with vibrant saturation. The iridescent coatings on the quartz clusters show consistent coverage and luster. No significant damage or repairs observed beyond natural geological variations.

Hand Carved Figural Smoking Pipe

These pieces represent a blend of utilitarian craftsmanship and creative folk art traditions.
Hand-carved wooden bowl with a human face motif
Two-piece construction with a removable wooden stem
Natural wood finish showing visible grain and hand-tool marks
Measures approximately 6 inches in length (ruler visible in photos)
